<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<pnml>
  <net id="original-net" type="http://www.pnml.org/version-2009/grammar/pnmlcoremodel">
    <page id="original-page">
      <place id="source">
        <name>
          <text>Original source</text>
        </name>
        <initialMarking>
          <text>1</text>
        </initialMarking>
      </place>
      <place id="left">
        <name>
          <text>Original left</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <place id="right">
        <name>
          <text>Original right</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <place id="sink">
        <name>
          <text>Original sink</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <transition id="original-transition-0">
        <toolspecific tool="ProM" version="6.4" activity="$invisible$" />
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-1">
        <name>
          <text>a</text>
        </name>
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-2">
        <toolspecific tool="ProM" version="6.4" activity="$invisible$" />
      </transition>
      <arc id="fan-in" source="source" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="fan-left" source="original-transition-0" target="left">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="fan-right" source="original-transition-0" target="right">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="a-left-in" source="left" target="original-transition-1">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="a-right-in" source="right" target="original-transition-1">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="a-left-out" source="original-transition-1" target="left">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="a-right-out" source="original-transition-1" target="right">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="exit-left" source="left" target="original-transition-2">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="exit-right" source="right" target="original-transition-2">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="exit-out" source="original-transition-2" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
    </page>
    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="sink">
          <text>1</text>
        </place>
      </marking>
    </finalmarkings>
  </net>
</pnml>
